title: 第18章 大比第19章 晋级
content_zh:
太始道宗，天鼎峰。
晨光初绽，薄雾如纱，缭绕于群山之间。
祭天坛广场上，七十二座擂台呈周天星斗之阵排开，每座擂台皆镌刻着古老符文，在曦光中流转着淡淡的灵辉。
中央矗立的太始道源碑巍然耸立，通体如墨，却在朝阳映照下泛起一层朦胧金光，仿佛亘古以来便在此默然见证着宗门兴衰。
许星遥静立于墨雪峰队列之中，一袭青衫随风轻动。
他抬眸环视，只见广场上人影攒动，各峰弟子皆已列阵而立。
今日参加大比的弟子足有三千余人，修为最低者也已踏入尘胎四脉之境，周身灵力隐现，气势不凡。
而如他这般达到六层修为的，虽非顶尖，却也已算中上之资，足以在此盛会中一展锋芒。
“肃静！”
一道浑厚如钟的声音骤然响彻广场，压下了所有嘈杂。
执事长老踏空而立，袖袍猎猎，目光如电扫过众弟子。
“大比规矩，只此一遍，尔等听仔细了！”
他声若雷霆，字字铿锵，广场上顿时鸦雀无声。
“其一，比斗只可使用法器与法术，禁用符箓、灵兽、毒物等外物辅助，违者剥夺大比资格！”
“其二，切磋为主，点到即止。
若有人故意重伤同门或行杀伐之举，立逐出宗门，绝不姑息！”
“其三，比斗期间不得服用任何丹药恢复灵力，违者当场判负！”
“其四，胜负之判有三：一方主动认输，或跌落擂台，或丧失再战之力。
三者有一，比斗即止！”
“其五，每场比斗限时一炷香。

若时限已至仍未分胜负，则由裁判长老依双方表现裁定！”
许星遥凝神静听，将每一条规矩皆铭记于心。
宗门大比虽为较量，却更重弟子对灵力的掌控与实战应变，而非生死相搏。
这些规矩，正是要引导弟子在切磋中明悟己身，而非一味争强斗狠。
“抽签开始！”
执事长老袖袍一挥，霎时间，数千道灵光如流星般划破长空，精准落入每位弟子手中。
许星遥摊开掌心，一枚温润玉符静静悬浮，其上灵纹闪烁，渐渐浮现出“七十二擂，第三场”
的字样。
“看来我们无缘同台了。”
林澈不知何时已凑了过来，晃了晃手中玉符，咧嘴一笑，“我在十八擂，第一场便要上场。”
周若渊亦缓步走近，指尖轻点玉符，温声道：“四十五擂，第二场。”
许星遥微微颔首，目光投向远处如星罗棋布的擂台，轻声道：“既如此，我便先去观战，也好瞧瞧此次大比有哪些值得留意的对手。”
前三轮的比斗对于许星遥三人而言，不过是牛刀小试。
那些修为明显逊色一筹的对手，在他们精妙的功法面前，几乎难以招架。
擂台上的水渍尚未蒸干，林澈反手将双戟收回背后。
对手踉跄跌坐在三丈外的试道石上，衣襟残留着被沧浪戟气撕开的裂口，正以肉眼可见的速度渗出浅蓝水痕，这是林家《沧浪戟法》特有的缚灵印。
众人只见他方才旋身时戟刃搅动的水雾里，隐约凝成两条半透明龙形，缠住对手足踝的刹那，戟尖已点到对方喉前三寸。
周若渊那里的擂台却飘着零落竹叶。
碧玉洞箫尾端悬着的冰蚕丝穗犹在轻颤，最后一个音符化作青翠藤蔓缠绕在对手脖颈。
那丹鼎峰弟子涨红着脸，手中药锄上的灵火已被箫声里渗出的雨露浇灭三次。

当周若渊吹出《青木引》第三叠变调时，试道石突然生长出碗口粗的虬结青藤，将对手缚成个碧色茧蛹。
许星遥的寒髓剑镜此刻正悬在擂台东北角，镜面倒映着日光。
方才施展《冰剑诀》第二式时，数道冰锥呈天罡阵排列，将对手祭出的赤炎轮生生冻在半空。
众人清晰看见冰晶里封存的火焰保持着爆燃姿态，那离火峰弟子握锤的虎口还凝结着霜花。
三人都是三战皆胜！
content_en:
Taishi Daozong, Tianding Peak.
The morning light is beginning to shine, and the mist is like a veil, lingering among the mountains.
On the Temple of Heaven Square, seventy-two arenas are arranged in a formation of stars in the sky. Each arena is engraved with ancient runes, and a faint spiritual glow flows in the sunlight.
The Taishi Daoyuan Monument standing in the center stands tall and majestic. Its whole body is like ink, but under the reflection of the morning sun, it casts a hazy golden light, as if it has been here silently witnessing the rise and fall of the sect since ancient times.
Xu Xing stood quietly in the queue at Mo Xuefeng, his green shirt fluttering in the wind.
He raised his eyes and looked around, only to see people moving around in the square, and disciples from all peaks were already standing in formation.
There are more than 3,000 disciples participating in the competition today, and the ones with the lowest cultivation level have already entered the realm of the four veins of the mortal body. Their spiritual power is looming all over their bodies, and their aura is extraordinary.
As for someone who has reached the sixth level of cultivation like him, although he is not the top, he is still considered to be above average, enough to show off his talents in this grand event.
"Quiet!"
A voice as rich as a bell suddenly resounded through the square, suppressing all the noise.
The elder deacon stood in the air, his sleeves robe hunting, and his eyes swept over the disciples like lightning.
"This is the only rule for the competition. Please listen carefully!"
His voice was like thunder and every word was sonorous, and the square was suddenly silent.
"First, only magic weapons and spells can be used in the competition, and external aids such as talismans, spiritual beasts, poisons, etc. are prohibited. Violators will be deprived of their qualifications for the competition!"
"Secondly, discussion is the main thing, and it ends when the point is reached.
If someone intentionally seriously injures a fellow sect member or commits an act of killing, he will be immediately expelled from the sect and will not be tolerated! "
"Third, you are not allowed to take any pills to restore your spiritual power during the competition. Anyone who violates this rule will be deemed a loser on the spot!"
"Fourth, there are three ways to determine victory or defeat: one party voluntarily admits defeat, or falls off the ring, or loses the ability to fight again.
If there is one out of three, then the competition will end! "
“Fifth, each competition is limited to one stick of incense.
If the time limit expires and there is still no winner, the referee will make the decision based on the performance of both parties! "
Xu Xingyao listened attentively and kept every rule in mind.
Although the sect competition is a competition, it puts more emphasis on the disciples' control of spiritual power and actual combat response, rather than a life-and-death struggle.
These rules are intended to guide disciples to understand themselves clearly during the competition, rather than blindly competing for strength and ruthlessness.
"The drawing begins!"
The elder deacon waved his sleeves, and in an instant, thousands of spiritual lights streaked across the sky like meteors, falling accurately into the hands of each disciple.
Xu Xingyao opened his palm, and a warm jade talisman floated quietly. The spiritual patterns on it flickered, and "Seventy-two rounds, the third game" gradually emerged.
of words.
"It seems we have no chance to share the stage."
Lin Che came over at some point, shook the jade talisman in her hand, and grinned, "I'm in the Eighteenth Ring, and I'm going to play in the first game."
Zhou Ruoyuan also approached slowly, tapped the jade talisman with his fingertips, and said warmly: "Forty-five rounds, the second round."
Xu Xingyao nodded slightly, looked at the star-studded arena in the distance, and said softly: "In that case, I will go to watch the battle first, so that I can see which opponents are worth paying attention to in this competition."
The first three rounds of competition were just a small test for Xu Xingyao and the others.
Opponents whose cultivation levels were obviously inferior were almost unable to withstand their exquisite skills.
Before the water stains on the arena had evaporated, Lin Che put her halberds back behind her back.
The opponent staggered and fell on the test stone three feet away. There were still cracks in the skirt of his clothes that were torn apart by the Canglang Halberd Qi. Light blue water marks were leaking out at a speed visible to the naked eye. This was the unique spirit binding seal of the Lin family's "Canglang Halberd Technique".
Everyone saw that when he just turned around, the water mist stirred by the halberd blade vaguely condensed into two translucent dragon shapes. The moment they wrapped around the opponent's ankles, the tip of the halberd had already touched three inches in front of the opponent's throat.
The arena at Zhou Ruoyuan's place was filled with scattered bamboo leaves.
The ice silk tassel hanging from the end of the jade cave flute was still trembling slightly, and the last note turned into a green vine and wrapped around the opponent's neck.
The Danding Peak disciple blushed, and the spiritual fire on the medicine hoe in his hand had been extinguished three times by the rain and dew seeping out of the flute.
When Zhou Ruoyuan blew outWhen the tone of "Aoki Hiki" changes in the third layer, the test stone suddenly grows a bowl-shaped thick knotted ivy, binding the opponent into a green cocoon.
Xu Xingyao's cold marrow sword mirror was currently hanging in the northeast corner of the arena, the mirror reflecting sunlight.
When the second form of "Ice Sword Technique" was performed just now, several ice cones were arranged in a Tiangang formation, freezing the red flame wheel offered by the opponent in mid-air.
Everyone could clearly see that the flames sealed in the ice crystals were still igniting, and the tiger's mouth where the Lihuo Peak disciple held the hammer was still covered with frost.
All three of them won all three battles!
